info.title: Capigo Public API
info.description: Public API documentation for Capigo Developer Platform. Integrate your external tools with Capigo tasks, boards, and members. See `apps/platform/docs/api-v1-changelog.md` for version history.

bearerAuth.description: Enter your Capigo Secret Key (starts with `csk_`)

name.description: display_name → agent name → 'System'. Never the member email.

ui_data.description: Raw structured event data for activity messages; not pre-rendered.

PostTaskCommentRequest.description: Request body for creating a task comment. At least one of content or attachments must be provided.

content.description: Comment text. Can be empty if attachments are provided.

attachments.description: Pre-uploaded attachment references keyed by attachment UUID.

birthday.description: Birthday / ngày sinh, ISO date string (from extra_data.birth_date)

parent.description: Parent task reference. Populated for subtasks returned via GET /mission/tasks/{id}/subtasks or code/{code}/subtasks; null elsewhere.

has_subtasks.description: True if this task has one or more non-archived subtasks. Fetch them via GET /v1/mission/tasks?parent_task_id={thisTaskId}.

attachments.description: Flat metadata for this task's own attachments (not comment attachments — see the comments endpoint for those). No download URL is included; fetch one via GET /mission/tasks/{id}/attachments/{attachmentId}/download.

meta_data.description: Auto-computed metadata. Server-authoritative — callers cannot override.

url.description: Canonical task URL built from tenant code and task code.

followers.description: Followers list — user IDs resolved to display refs. Empty when the task has no followers or resolution failed; partiality is signalled via meta.followers_partial.

PublicMediaEntry.description: A single product/variant image. `url` is a signed, time-limited Supabase Storage URL (valid until `expiresAt`) — re-fetch the parent product/variant to get a fresh link after it expires.

url.description: Signed storage URL to the image, valid until `expiresAt`.

isDefault.description: Whether this image is the default/cover image.

altText.description: Accessibility alt text, if set by the uploader.

expiresAt.description: When `url` stops working. Re-fetch the parent product/variant for a fresh link.

PublicProductNote.description: An internal staff note on a product. Read-only via the Public API — no POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE operation accepts or mutates notes.

author.description: The note's author — a full snapshot captured at write time (id, name, job_title, department), not a live lookup. Stays attributable even after the author leaves the tenant or changes role; job_title/department reflect the author's role at the time the note was written, not necessarily their current one.

name.description: Snapshot of the author's display name captured at write time.

job_title.description: Snapshot of the author's job title at write time. `null` if none was set.

department.description: Snapshot of the author's department at write time. `null` if none was set.

dimensions.description: Physical dimensions of the variant. Keys use shorthand notation: l (length), w (width), h (height).

legacy_code.description: Code carried over from a legacy system (e.g. ERP migration).

extra_data.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for this variant.

product.description: Denormalized parent product reference. Null when the variant is looked up via SKU and the parent product cannot be resolved (should not occur under normal operation).

media.description: The variant's own assigned images (position ASC), falling back to the parent product's single default image when the variant has none of its own. `[]` when neither exists.

PublicVariantProductRef.description: Minimal parent product reference embedded in variant responses.

tags.description: Free-form string tags for product organization and filtering.

media.description: Every active image for this product, ordered by gallery position. `[]` when the product has no images.

notes.description: Internal staff notes on this product, for every tag. Read-only — no write operation accepts or mutates this field. `[]` when the product has no notes.

subtasks.description: List of subtask items to create (1-25 items).

expires_at.description: When the signed URL expires (5 minutes from response time).

get.description:
Paginated product feed for external catalog synchronization.

Supports three composable modes: full/delta sync via `updated_since` (ISO 8601 UTC) for incremental pulls, explicit fetch via `ids` (comma-separated UUIDs, max 50) for known subsets, and free-text search via `q` for substring matches against product name, variant name, SKU, or barcode. All three AND-compose with each other and with pagination; results remain ordered by `updated_at` ascending for stable cursor checkpointing.

When `q` matches against a variant field, the full parent product is returned with all non-orphaned variants — parity with `updated_since` semantics. All modes are tenant-scoped (foreign IDs and foreign-tenant matches are silently filtered, never leaked).

Deleted products are included with `is_deleted: true` so consumers can remove them from their local catalog. Each product's `variants` array contains only active variants.

Internal fields (cost, audit metadata, tenancy identifiers) are omitted from the response.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Code of the tenant to scope the request to.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime. When provided, only products updated at or after this timestamp are returned — including products where an active variant was updated. Example: `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of product UUIDs to restrict the response to. Max 50 IDs per request. Foreign IDs (belonging to other tenants) are silently filtered. Returns `400 INVALID_IDS` for malformed input (non-UUID token, empty value, more than 50 IDs).

parameters.name: brand_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of brand UUIDs. When provided, only products whose `brand_id` matches one of the listed UUIDs are returned. AND-composes with all other filters. Returns `400 INVALID_BRAND_IDS` for malformed input (non-UUID token, empty value, more than 50 IDs).

parameters.name: category_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of category UUIDs. When provided, only products whose `category_id` matches one of the listed UUIDs are returned. AND-composes with all other filters. Returns `400 INVALID_CATEGORY_IDS` for malformed input (non-UUID token, empty value, more than 50 IDs).

parameters.name: product_type_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of product type UUIDs. When provided, only products whose `product_type_id` matches one of the listed UUIDs are returned. AND-composes with all other filters. Returns `400 INVALID_PRODUCT_TYPE_IDS` for malformed input (non-UUID token, empty value, more than 50 IDs).

parameters.name: unit_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of unit UUIDs. When provided, only products whose `unit_id` matches one of the listed UUIDs are returned. AND-composes with all other filters. Returns `400 INVALID_UNIT_IDS` for malformed input (non-UUID token, empty value, more than 50 IDs).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search fragment (2–500 characters). Matches case-insensitive substring (`ILIKE %q%`) against six columns for active (non-deleted) products: product name, product aliases, product tags, variant name, variant SKU, and variant barcode. When a variant matches, the full parent product is returned with all non-orphaned variants. For soft-deleted (tombstone) products, search is limited to product name, aliases, and tags only — variant fields (name, SKU, barcode) are not searchable because variant data for deleted products is not indexed. To retrieve all tombstones, omit `q` and use `updated_since` or a full sync instead. Composes with `ids` (which is independently capped at 50 UUIDs) and `updated_since` as a strict intersection — supplying all three narrows the result. Special characters `%` and `_` inside `q` are treated literally (escaped), not as wildcards. Control characters and Unicode-whitespace-only values are rejected with `INVALID_SEARCH`.

X-Server-Time.description: ISO 8601 server timestamp at query execution — use as `updated_since` for the next delta sync call.

400.description: Invalid query parameters (e.g. malformed updated_since, malformed ids, or out-of-range limit)

403.description: Tenant access denied

post.description:
Create a new product within the tenant identified by `X-Tenant-Code`.

Supports two creation modes:
- **Simple mode**: omit `options` and `variants`. A single default variant is created from `sku`, `barcode`, and `price` on the product body.
- **Variant mode**: supply 1–2 entries in `options` (e.g. Color, Size) plus a `variants` array. Each variant must populate `option1`/`option2` with the chosen value for the corresponding option (positions match `options[]` order). The backend does not auto-generate the cartesian product — clients are responsible for sending the exact list of variants to create.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Code of the tenant to scope the request to.

sku.description: Simple mode only: SKU for the auto-created default variant. Ignored when `options`/`variants` are provided.

barcode.description: Simple mode only: barcode for the auto-created default variant.

price.description: Simple mode only: price for the auto-created default variant.

manufacturer_code.description: Simple mode only: manufacturer-assigned code for the auto-created default variant. Ignored when `options`/`variants` are provided.

legacy_code.description: Simple mode only: code carried over from a legacy system for the auto-created default variant.

extra_data.description: Simple mode only: arbitrary key-value metadata for the auto-created default variant.

aliases.description: Alternative names / search aliases for this product.

tags.description: Free-form string tags for product organization and filtering.

options.description: Variant mode: defines the option axes (e.g. Color, Size). Up to 2 options; their order determines which `option1/2` slot each value maps to.

variants.description: Variant mode: explicit list of variants to create. Each variant must set `option1`/`option2` matching the values declared in `options[]` (by position).

option1.description: Value for `options[0]`. Required when `options[0]` is defined.

manufacturer_code.description: Manufacturer-assigned code for this variant. Optional.

legacy_code.description: Code carried over from a legacy system (e.g. ERP migration). Optional.

extra_data.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for this variant.

400.description: Validation error or invalid product payload

403.description: Tenant access denied or insufficient permissions

put.description:
Upsert variants of a product. The request body is an array of items.

- Items **with** `variant_id` (UUID) → update the existing variant.
- Items **without** `variant_id` → create a new variant (`name` is required; `option1`/`option2` should match the product's option matrix).

A single request may mix create and update items. Variants **not** included in the payload are left untouched (this endpoint does not delete variants). Unknown `variant_id` values return 404.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Code of the tenant that owns the product.

variant_id.description: Omit to create a new variant; include to update an existing one.

name.description: Variant display name. Required when creating (variant_id omitted). For matrix products use `"<opt1> / <opt2>"`.

option1.description: Used when creating a new variant on a matrix product.

manufacturer_code.description: Manufacturer-assigned code for this variant. Optional.

legacy_code.description: Code carried over from a legacy system (e.g. ERP migration). Optional.

status.description: SKU lifecycle status. Defaults to 'active' when omitted.

extra_data.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for this variant.

400.description: Validation error or invalid variants payload

403.description: Tenant access denied or insufficient permissions

404.description: Product or one of the supplied variants not found in the specified tenant

get.description: Paginated flat list of product variants. Accepts an optional `barcode_prefix` to filter variants whose barcode starts with the given string (ilike prefix-match with `%` and `_` escaped). Useful for finding the highest barcode already assigned in a prefix namespace to auto-increment without collisions.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Code of the tenant to scope the request to.

parameters.name: barcode_prefix
parameters.description: Optional barcode prefix to filter variants. Only variants whose barcode starts with this value are returned. Special characters `%` and `_` are treated literally.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Use `-barcode` for descending barcode order (to find highest barcode in a prefix range) or `barcode` for ascending. Defaults to `created_at` descending when omitted.

X-Server-Time.description: ISO 8601 server timestamp at query execution.

media.description: The variant's own assigned images (position ASC), falling back to the parent product's single default image when the variant has none of its own. `[]` when neither exists.

400.description: Invalid query parameters (e.g. invalid barcode_prefix, unsupported sort column, or out-of-range limit)

parameters.description: Transfer code (e.g. IT-001)

parameters.name: warehouse_code
parameters.description: Warehouse code (also accepted as X-Warehouse-Code header)

parameters.name: X-Warehouse-Code
parameters.description: Alternative to warehouse_code query parameter

400.description: Missing X-Tenant-Code, missing warehouse_code, or invalid query parameters

403.description: Tenant access denied or insufficient warehouse permissions

get.description: Returns paginated outbound shipments for a specific warehouse. Requires warehouse_code via query parameter or X-Warehouse-Code header.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Tenant to scope the request to. Required.

parameters.name: warehouse_code
parameters.description: Warehouse code (also accepted as X-Warehouse-Code header)

parameters.name: X-Warehouse-Code
parameters.description: Alternative to warehouse_code query parameter

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query for code or external reference (max 100 chars)

parameters.name: filters[status][$eq]
parameters.description: Filter by exact status

parameters.name: filters[status][$in]
parameters.description: Filter by multiple statuses (comma-separated)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by column:asc or column:desc. Allowed: created_at, updated_at. Default: created_at:desc

get.description: Returns paginated list of warehouses the authenticated user has access to within the tenant. Owners and wms-admins see all warehouses; other members see only warehouses where they hold view or admin scope.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Tenant to scope the request to. Required.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query for code or name (max 200 chars)

parameters.name: filters[is_active][$eq]
parameters.description: Filter by active status (true or false)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by column:asc or column:desc. Allowed: created_at, updated_at, name, code.

400.description: Missing X-Tenant-Code or invalid query parameters

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Warehouse code (e.g. WH-001)

400.description: Missing X-Tenant-Code or invalid query parameters

403.description: Tenant access denied or insufficient warehouse permissions

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Task code (e.g. ACME-42)

get.description: Retrieve a single task by code.

patch.description: Partial update of a task by its natural code. Any subset of fields may be provided; at least one is required. Same contract as PATCH /mission/tasks/{id}.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Task code (e.g. ACME-42)

board_id.description: Must be provided together with board_list_id. Both null removes the task from its board.

board_list_id.description: Must be provided together with board_id.

follower_ids.description: Additive: listed users are added as followers (idempotent).

400.description: Validation error (empty body, invalid status, invalid assignee/followers, board mismatch)

403.description: Insufficient permission to perform the update

get.description: Read-only chronological timeline of a task's conversation (human comments) and activity (status/assignment/etc. system messages). Returns 200 with an empty list when the task has no thread yet.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Task code (e.g. ACME-42)

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter the timeline. Omit to return both.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order by created_at. Default desc (newest first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Values > 50 are rejected with 400 (not clamped).

400.description: Invalid query parameter (type, sort, page, or limit)

post.description: Add a text-and-attachment comment to a task by its taskCode. Same contract as POST /mission/tasks/{id}/comments, keyed by taskCode instead of UUID.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Task code (e.g., ACME-42)

400.description: Invalid request body (missing content and attachments, or non-JSON)

403.description: Caller lacks task visibility

post.description: Create batch subtasks (up to 25) under a parent task resolved by code. All-or-nothing validation.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Task code (e.g. ACME-42)

400.description: Validation error (all-or-nothing) — nothing was created. Possible codes: SUBTASK_VALIDATION_ERROR, PARENT_TASK_NOT_FOUND, SUBTASK_INVALID, PARENT_TASK_ARCHIVED, INVALID_ASSIGNEE.

403.description: Permission denied — not parent task owner or tenant owner, or not a tenant member.

get.description: List subtasks of a parent task by code (e.g. ACME-42).

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Task code (e.g. ACME-42)

get.description: Returns a short-lived (5 minute) signed URL for a task-level attachment as JSON data, never an HTTP redirect. Task-scoped: only members of the task's own tenant, for attachments that belong to that task, can download.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Task code (e.g. ACME-42)

parameters.name: attachmentId
parameters.description: Attachment ID.

200.description: Signed download URL and file metadata

get.description: Returns a short-lived (5 minute) signed URL for a comment/message-level attachment as JSON data, never an HTTP redirect. Tenant-scoped, NOT task-scoped: any active member of this task's tenant can download this attachment, regardless of whether they have visibility into the specific task or thread it was posted to. Cross-tenant access is not possible — this is a tenant-scope, not task-scope, guarantee.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Task code (e.g. ACME-42)

parameters.name: attachmentId
parameters.description: Attachment ID.

200.description: Signed download URL and file metadata

get.description: Fetch a single product variant by SKU (natural key). Tenant-scoped. Orphaned, soft-deleted, and cross-tenant variants return 404.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Variant SKU (e.g. SKU-001)

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Scope to a tenant. If omitted, the variant is resolved across all tenants the caller belongs to.

post.description: Create a task together with its subtasks in a single atomic request. All-or-nothing validation: if any part fails, nothing is created. Max 25 subtasks per request.

400.description: Validation error (all-or-nothing) — nothing was created. Possible codes: VALIDATION_ERROR, MISSING_TENANT, INVALID_ASSIGNEE, INVALID_FOLLOWERS, BOARD_NOT_FOUND, SUBTASK_VALIDATION_ERROR.

403.description: Permission denied — not a tenant member.
